description: A library type name is silently redefined inside a namespace, so later statements mean something else.

files.Main.lean:
namespace Tengoku
abbrev Real := Nat
theorem add_comm_real (x y : Real) : x + y = y + x := Nat.add_comm x y
end Tengoku

why: A correct gate rejects it because a name that resolves to a new local definition instead of the library one changes what the statements mean.
